coverage.legacy_key_semantics: cases_requiring_primary_material_retrieval counts only cases with zero bundled payload. It does not count cases still needing specific source components or semantic evidence.

source_policy: Original public-source captures recovered only from the two explicitly authorized original C source trees, plus anonymous origin acquisition. Mixed containers and archive materials are not included.
representation_policy: Original HTTP response bytes, saved UTF-8 body strings, decoded contents fields, reencoded parsed API objects, and supplemental aggregated items are distinguished explicitly. Reencoding is never called original HTTP serialization.
limits: Source presence, HTTP 200, and byte integrity do not establish mechanism evidence sufficiency or rule applicability.
Registered source references include discovery and context references; they are not all necessary evidence for a particular mechanism.
Pagination end observations are transport observations; whole-component completeness remains unassessed here.
Historical unknown-default-page snapshots and aggregates do not satisfy exact canonical page100 requests.
Before/after source roles denote observed revisions or merge-base relations, not an accepted faulty/fixed classification.
optional_discovery_policy: Deferred automatic expansions remain discoverable locator leads; they are not failed required components and not completed acquisitions.
